name: Betrayal from Within
summary: At Camp Taurajo, Mangletooth offers Horde travelers a path to vengeance. His Razormane kin left him for dead, and he names three warlords from Razorfen Kraul who direct attacks across the Barrens.

sections.title: A Grudge in a Cage
sections.body: Mangletooth sits in a cage at Camp Taurajo, abandoned by his Razormane kin after their defeat. He has lost all loyalty to them and now faces execution. He offers Horde travelers knowledge of the leaders behind the ruthless raids across the plains, hoping to see those leaders fall before his own end.

sections.title: The Warlords of the Kraul
sections.body: Razormane attacks trouble the Horde, while Thork at the Crossroads struggles to curb them. Mangletooth names three commanders from deep within Razorfen Kraul: Lok Orcbane, a formidable warrior, and his companions Nak, a tracker, and Kuz, a spellcaster. They direct raiders from encampments far to the south. Mangletooth demands their severed skulls as proof that his betrayers have fallen before his own end arrives.

faq.q: Why is a quilboar helping the Horde?
faq.answer: Mangletooth helps the Horde for revenge, not friendship. His brethren left him to die in a cage at Camp Taurajo. Believing his own death inevitable, he wants his betrayers dead first.

faq.q: Who are Nak, Kuz, and Lok Orcbane?
faq.answer: Nak, Kuz, and Lok Orcbane are three Razormane leaders who emerged from Razorfen Kraul to organize raids across the Barrens. Lok Orcbane is a vicious warrior, with Nak the tracker and Kuz the spellcaster at his side.

faq.q: Where are the three targets found?
faq.answer: They make their camps far to the south of the Barrens, within Razormane territories near the southern brushlands.

faq.q: What does Mangletooth mean about Thork being wrong?
faq.answer: Thork manages defenses from the Crossroads and believes he knows who directs the quilboar attacks on Horde supply lines. Mangletooth says Thork is wrong: Lok Orcbane, Nak, and Kuz direct those attacks.

faq.q: Will killing these leaders truly bring peace with the Razormane?
faq.answer: Mangletooth claims that killing the three will ease Razormane raids on the Crossroads and much of the Barrens. Their fall would break the immediate southern leadership, but quilboar hostility across the Barrens would remain.

faq.q: What happens to Mangletooth after this?
faq.answer: Mangletooth believes death is inescapable while he is locked in a Horde encampment. He seeks neither escape nor mercy, only the satisfaction of bringing down his treacherous tribe mates before his end.

angles.text: Stopping Lok Orcbane and his cohorts strikes at the leaders responsible for brutalizing Horde caravans and outposts across the southern Barrens.
Lok Orcbane bears that name for his prowess and hatred in slaughtering orcish travelers across the territory.
Camp Taurajo lies along the southern corridor where Razormane aggression runs hottest, making these warlords' deaths critical to local security.
